reviews.comment: REQUEST CHANGES: (1) X-Forwarded-Host is honored from ANY loopback peer and overwrites Host BEFORE the Host check — the user's own browser is a loopback peer, so a DNS-rebinding page can set X-Forwarded-Host: localhost and read every GET route incl. /sse; check the real Host first, then validate the forwarded host too. (2) findFreePort still binds all interfaces while dashboards bind 127.0.0.1 (checklist claimed otherwise) — on macOS the probe reports held ports as free.

fix.comment: Fixed blockers 1-2 (X-Forwarded-Host rebinding + findFreePort bind) and non-blocking #1-#5; 4 regression tests added, 11/11 green
